purpose: numerical timestep-refinement audit of installed experimental candidates

fuel_accounting.method: trapezoidal integration of the fuel-transport state (continuous index 5) sampled every 0.1 s
fuel_accounting.starter_prime: The takeoff case calls glow_start before its initial snapshot; that start routine deducts the metered starter_prime_kg from tank inventory. Therefore the reported integral begins after priming and does not count priming as engine consumption.
fuel_accounting.exhaustion_intervention: At 0.5 s the exhaustion case directly overwrites tank inventory with 1e-7 kg. Inventory change includes this test intervention and is reported separately; it is not labeled fuel burned or delivered.
fuel_accounting.inventory_change_field: sampled_fuel_inventory_change_kg is initial sampled inventory minus final sampled inventory and may include explicit case interventions; use integrated_delivered_fuel_kg for the convergence comparison.
fuel_accounting.integration_limit: Fuel delivery is reconstructed from 0.1 s saved rates, not an independently recorded cumulative fuel meter.

event_timing_limit.model: Mean-cycle work has no crank-angle-resolved torque ripple; firing opportunity/fire counters advance on accepted simulation steps.
event_timing_limit.limitation: The report compares endpoint event counts only. It cannot establish cycle pulse timing or event phase against a measured cycle oracle; no matched physical cycle trace is available.

source_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the current checked-out runner and runtime sources at report generation; the bench configuration does not record per-module source hashes.
